note: Raw per-guna bands are on the 1-6 item-average scale (no neutral midpoint, forced-choice). Dominance patterns use each guna's share of the total AFTER subtracting the scale floor (mean - 1, i.e. a 0-5 scale), so the three shares sum to 100 and span the full 0-100 range instead of being compressed toward 33%. Rules are applied in order; the first match wins. Gunas are relative to each other, so the shares drive the pattern and the raw means show absolute intensity.

bands.label: Low clarity
bands.description: Discipline, contentment, and mental steadiness aren't currently strong pulls; more pulled by activity or inertia than by calm focus.

bands.label: Moderate clarity
bands.description: Some steadiness and discipline present, alongside other pulls; clarity comes and goes with circumstance.

bands.label: High clarity
bands.description: Strong pull toward discipline, truthfulness, and equanimity; generally composed and content.

bands.label: Low drive-restlessness
bands.description: Not particularly driven by desire or restless activity; comfortable with stillness and enough.

bands.label: Moderate drive
bands.description: Some ambition and restlessness, balanced by other tendencies.

bands.label: High drive-restlessness
bands.description: Strong pull toward striving, desire, and constant activity; rarely fully satisfied or still.

bands.label: Low inertia
bands.description: Not much pull toward procrastination, confusion, or heaviness; generally alert and engaged.

bands.label: Moderate inertia
bands.description: Some heaviness or avoidance shows up periodically, alongside more active or clear states.

bands.label: High inertia
bands.description: Strong pull toward confusion, low motivation, or resistance to change; effortful to get moving or think clearly.

dominance_patterns.condition: top guna >= 45% AND leads the second by >= 10 points
dominance_patterns.label: {guna}-dominant
dominance_patterns.description: One mode clearly leads and colors most of how this person operates day to day.

dominance_patterns.condition: top two gunas each >= 30%, third below 25%
dominance_patterns.label: {guna_a}-{guna_b} blend
dominance_patterns.description: Alternates between two modes depending on context, with the third rarely showing up.

dominance_patterns.label: Balanced / fluid
dominance_patterns.description: No single mode dominates; likely shifts noticeably with circumstances, sleep, stress, and company.

dominance_patterns.label: {guna}-leaning
dominance_patterns.description: One mode leads, but not strongly enough to call it dominant, and the other two are not clearly split. The leading mode is the one to watch for; the others still show up regularly.
